# Selection reference

The components that select units with the pointer and draw markers under them, the marker styles, and the selection API. For how to use it, see [Selection](../modules/selection.md).

## VtUnitSelection

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Selection → VtUnitSelection**.

Selects units with the pointer for the local player. A Select press (left-click by default) on a unit selects it, with Shift it adds or removes it, a drag draws a box that selects the units inside, a double-click selects every unit of the same kind on screen, and a press on the ground or the clear key clears the selection. Command presses stay with `VtTopDownClickInput` and `VtOrderInput`.

### Inspector fields

#### Side

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Viewer Faction (`viewerFaction`) | [VtFaction](#vtfaction) | `Player` |  | The faction relations and box filters are measured from when this object has no VtUnit, such as an RTS commander. |

#### Clicking

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unit Mask (`unitMask`) | `LayerMask` | Everything |  | Layers the click and hover raycast considers for units. |
| Ray Distance (`rayDistance`) | `float` | 500 | ≥ 1 | Max raycast distance, in world units. |
| Clear On Ground Click (`clearOnGroundClick`) | `bool` | On |  | A Select press that hits no unit clears the selection. |
| Select On Attack (`selectOnAttack`) | `bool` | On |  | An attack command selects its target, unless several units are selected. |
| Double Click Selects Same Kind (`doubleClickSelectsSameKind`) | `bool` | On |  | A double-click on a unit selects every unit with the same unit definition on screen. |
| Double Click Seconds (`doubleClickSeconds`) | `float` | 0.3 | ≥ 0.05 | Seconds between two clicks on the same unit that count as a double-click. |
| Select Action (`selectAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Selects and draws the box. Empty uses Select from the Vantage input actions, the left mouse button by default. |
| Command Action (`commandAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | The command button, read only to tell whether it shares a button with Select. Empty uses Command, the right mouse button by default. |
| Clear Action (`clearAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Clears the selection. Empty uses Cancel from the Vantage input actions, Esc by default. |
| Additive Action (`additiveAction`) | `InputActionReference` | None |  | Held to add to the selection instead of replacing it. Empty uses Additive Modifier, Shift by default. |

#### Box

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Box Selection (`boxSelection`) | `bool` | On |  | Dragging with Select held draws a box that selects the units inside it. |
| Drag Threshold (`dragThreshold`) | `float` | 6 | ≥ 0 | Pixels the pointer must move while pressed before the press becomes a box. |
| Box Filter (`boxFilter`) | [VtBoxSelectionFilter](#vtboxselectionfilter) | `PreferOwnFaction` |  | Which units a box keeps when it covers several sides. |
| Draw Box (`drawBox`) | `bool` | On |  | Draw the box on screen. Turn off to draw your own from IsBoxSelecting and BoxScreenRect. |
| Box Fill Color (`boxFillColor`) | `Color` | `#59BFFF1F` |  | Fill colour of the drawn box. |
| Box Border Color (`boxBorderColor`) | `Color` | `#59BFFFD9` |  | Border colour of the drawn box. |

#### Limits

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Max Selected (`maxSelected`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Most units selected at once. 0 = no limit. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IReadOnlyList<VtUnit> Selected { get; }` | The selected units, primary first. |
| `VtUnit Primary { get; }` | The primary selected unit, or null. |
| `int Count { get; }` | Number of selected units. |
| `VtUnit Hovered { get; }` | The selectable unit under the pointer, or null. Null while a box is drawn. |
| `bool IsBoxSelecting { get; }` | True while Select is held and the pointer has moved far enough to draw a box. |
| `Rect BoxScreenRect { get; }` | The box in screen pixels, origin at the bottom left. Empty when no box is drawn. |
| `VtFaction ViewerFaction { get; }` | The faction relations and box filters are measured from: the unit on this object, or Viewer Faction without one. |
| `bool ClearOnGroundClick { get; set; }` | A Select press that hits no unit clears the selection. |
| `bool SelectOnAttack { get; set; }` | An attack command selects its target, unless several units are selected. |
| `bool BoxSelection { get; set; }` | Dragging draws a box that selects the units inside it. |
| `VtBoxSelectionFilter BoxFilter { get; set; }` | Which units a box keeps when it covers several sides. |
| `int MaxSelected { get; set; }` | Most units selected at once. 0 = no limit. |
| `Func<Vector2, VtUnit> UnitAtScreenPoint { get; set; }` | Finds the unit at a screen position. Null uses a raycast from the main camera on `Unit Mask`. |
| `Func<Vector3, Vector3> WorldToScreen { get; set; }` | Maps a world position to screen pixels with the depth in z. Null uses the main camera. |
| `Func<Rect> ScreenRect { get; set; }` | The visible screen area in pixels, for double-click selection. Null uses the whole screen. |
| `Func<IEnumerable<VtUnit>> Candidates { get; set; }` | The units boxes and double-clicks consider. Null uses every registered unit. |
| `event Action OnSelectionChanged` | Fires after the selection changed. |
| `event Action<VtUnit> OnHoverChanged` | Fires when the hovered unit changed, with the new unit or null. |
| `bool IsSelected(VtUnit unit)` | True when `unit` is selected. |
| `void Select(VtUnit unit)` | Select only `unit`. Null or a unit that cannot be selected clears the selection. |
| `void SelectMany(IEnumerable<VtUnit> units)` | Replace the selection with the selectable units in `units`. |
| `void Add(VtUnit unit)` | Add `unit` to the selection. |
| `void Remove(VtUnit unit)` | Remove `unit` from the selection. |
| `void Toggle(VtUnit unit)` | Add `unit`, or remove it when it is already selected. |
| `void Clear()` | Deselect every unit. |
| `void SelectSameKindOnScreen(VtUnit unit, bool additive = false)` | Select every living unit with the same unit definition as `unit` that is on screen, with `unit` as the primary. With `additive` they are added. |
| `bool ClaimsSharedPress(Vector2 screenPosition)` | True when a press at `screenPosition` that is both Select and Command belongs to the selection: the pointer is on a unit that can be selected and that the viewer cannot attack on command. Every other shared press belongs to the command input. |
| `bool IsSharedPressThisFrame()` | True when Select and Command were both pressed this frame, as happens when they share a button. |
| `void NotifyAttackOrder(VtUnit target)` | Tell the selection an attack command was given. Selects `target` when `SelectOnAttack` is on and at most one unit is selected. |
| `void PointerDown(Vector2 screenPosition)` | Select went down at `screenPosition`. Ignored while a ground ability is aimed. |
| `void PointerMove(Vector2 screenPosition)` | The pointer is at `screenPosition`. Updates the hover and turns a press into a box once it moved past the drag threshold. |
| `void PointerUp(Vector2 screenPosition, bool additive, double time)` | Select came up at `screenPosition`. Finishes a box or a click. `additive` is true while Shift is held; `time` is in seconds and detects double-clicks. |

## VtSelectionIndicator

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Selection → VtSelectionIndicator**. Adds [VtUnitSelection](#vtunitselection) automatically.

Draws a marker under every unit the sibling `VtUnitSelection` has selected, and under the hovered unit. Markers take the colour of the unit relation and the size of the unit. The look comes from a `VtSelectionStyle`: pick a package preset, make a ring style of your own, point a prefab style at any prefab, or subclass the style.

### Inspector fields

#### Look

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Style (`style`) | [VtSelectionStyle](#vtselectionstyle) | None |  | Style for selected units. Empty = a plain thin ring. |
| Hover Style (`hoverStyle`) | [VtSelectionStyle](#vtselectionstyle) | None |  | Style for the hovered unit. Empty = the selected style. |
| Show Hover (`showHover`) | `bool` | On |  | Show a marker under the unit the pointer is over. |

#### Colours

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Friendly Color (`friendlyColor`) | `Color` | `#59F273F2` |  | Units of the selecting side. |
| Hostile Color (`hostileColor`) | `Color` | `#FF5242F2` |  | Units that fight the selecting side. |
| Neutral Color (`neutralColor`) | `Color` | `#FFD94CF2` |  | Every other unit. |
| Hover Alpha (`hoverAlpha`) | `float` | 0.45 | 0 to 1 | Alpha multiplier for the marker of a hovered unit that is not selected. |

#### Size

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Radius Padding (`radiusPadding`) | `float` | 0.15 | ≥ 0 | World units added to the unit radius. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtSelectionStyle Style { get; set; }` | Style for selected units. Null = a plain thin ring. Changing it rebuilds the markers. |
| `VtSelectionStyle HoverStyle { get; set; }` | Style for the hovered unit. Null = `Style`. |
| `bool ShowHover { get; set; }` | Show a marker under the hovered unit. |
| `float HoverAlpha { get; set; }` | Alpha multiplier for the marker of a hovered unit that is not selected. |
| `float RadiusPadding { get; set; }` | World units added to the unit radius. |
| `int MarkerCount { get; }` | Number of markers shown, selected and hovered. |
| `VtSelectionMarker MarkerFor(VtUnit unit)` | The marker shown for `unit`, or null. |
| `Color ColorFor(VtSelectionRelation relation)` | The colour for `relation`. |
| `static float ResolveRadius(VtUnit unit, float padding)` | The marker radius for `unit`: the unit definition Selection Radius when set, otherwise the radius of its character controller or collider, scaled, plus `padding`. |
| `void Refresh(float deltaTime)` | Create, move and remove markers to match the selection. Runs every frame in LateUpdate; call it yourself to drive the indicator from elsewhere. |
| `void ClearMarkers()` | Destroy every marker. They are created again on the next `Refresh`. |

## VtRingSelectionMarker

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Selection → VtRingSelectionMarker**. Inherits [VtSelectionMarker](#vtselectionmarker).

The marker a `VtRingSelectionStyle` creates: a generated ring mesh that follows its unit, rebuilt when the radius changes and tinted through a material property block.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `Mesh Mesh { get; }` | The generated ring mesh. |
| `void Configure(VtRingSelectionStyle ringStyle)` | Take shape and material from `ringStyle`. |
| `override void Apply(in VtSelectionMarkerState state, float deltaTime)` | Move the ring to the unit, rebuild it when the radius changed, turn it and tint it. |

## VtPrefabSelectionMarker

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Selection → VtPrefabSelectionMarker**. Inherits [VtSelectionMarker](#vtselectionmarker).

The marker a `VtPrefabSelectionStyle` adds to a prefab without its own `VtSelectionMarker`: follows the unit, scales by the radius, turns, and tints every renderer through a material property block.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `void Configure(VtPrefabSelectionStyle prefabStyle)` | Take placement and tint settings from `prefabStyle`. |
| `override void Apply(in VtSelectionMarkerState state, float deltaTime)` | Move the marker to the unit, scale it by the radius when the style asks for it, turn it and tint it. |

## VtRingSelectionStyle

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Selection → Ring Style**. Inherits [VtSelectionStyle](#vtselectionstyle).

A selection style that draws a generated ring: thin or wide, hard or soft edged, solid or dashed, still or turning. The package presets ThinRing, SoftRing, Brackets and SpinningDashes are assets of this type.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Material (`material`) | `Material` | None |  | Material for the ring. Empty = a transparent unlit material made at runtime. Softness needs a shader that multiplies vertex colour, such as URP Particles Unlit. |
| Thickness (`thickness`) | `float` | 0.08 | ≥ 0.005 | Width of the ring in world units, measured inward from the marker radius. |
| Softness (`softness`) | `float` | 0 | 0 to 1 | Share of the width that fades out at both edges. 0 = hard edges. |
| Dashes (`dashes`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Number of dashes. 0 = a solid ring. 4 with a low Dash Fill draws corner brackets. |
| Dash Fill (`dashFill`) | `float` | 0.5 | 0.02 to 1 | Share of each dash slot that is drawn. |
| Spin Degrees Per Second (`spinDegreesPerSecond`) | `float` | 0 |  | Degrees per second the ring turns. 0 = still. |
| Radius Scale (`radiusScale`) | `float` | 1 | ≥ 0.1 | Multiplies the marker radius, for a ring further out or closer in. |
| Height Offset (`heightOffset`) | `float` | 0.04 | ≥ 0 | Height above the unit position, so the ring does not sink into the ground. |
| Segments (`segments`) | `int` | 64 | 8 to 256 | Segments in a full circle. More is smoother. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override VtSelectionMarker CreateMarker()` | Create a ring marker with this style's shape and material. |

## VtPrefabSelectionStyle

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Selection → Prefab Style**. Inherits [VtSelectionStyle](#vtselectionstyle).

A selection style that uses any prefab as the marker: a decal projector, a textured quad, a mesh or particles, authored for a radius of 1. The marker is placed at the unit, scaled by the radius and tinted with the relation colour. When the prefab carries its own `VtSelectionMarker`, that component drives it instead.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prefab (`prefab`) | `GameObject` | None |  | The marker prefab, authored for a radius of 1. A VtSelectionMarker component on it takes over placing, sizing and colouring. |
| Scale With Radius (`scaleWithRadius`) | `bool` | On |  | Scale the prefab by the marker radius. |
| Tint (`tint`) | `bool` | On |  | Tint the prefab renderers with the relation colour through _BaseColor and _Color. |
| Spin Degrees Per Second (`spinDegreesPerSecond`) | `float` | 0 |  | Degrees per second the marker turns. 0 = still. |
| Height Offset (`heightOffset`) | `float` | 0.04 | ≥ 0 | Height above the unit position. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override VtSelectionMarker CreateMarker()` | Instantiate the prefab as a marker. Uses the prefab's own `VtSelectionMarker` when it has one. Returns null when no prefab is set. |

## VtSelectionStyle

Abstract asset base. Shipped subclasses: [VtPrefabSelectionStyle](#vtprefabselectionstyle), [VtRingSelectionStyle](#vtringselectionstyle).

The look of selection markers. The package ships `VtRingSelectionStyle`, with presets, and `VtPrefabSelectionStyle` for any prefab. A new look is a subclass that returns its own `VtSelectionMarker`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `abstract VtSelectionMarker CreateMarker()` | Create one marker. `VtSelectionIndicator` owns it and destroys it when its unit is no longer shown. Return null to show nothing. |

## VtSelectionMarker

Abstract component base. Shipped subclasses: [VtPrefabSelectionMarker](#vtprefabselectionmarker), [VtRingSelectionMarker](#vtringselectionmarker).

One marker under a selected or hovered unit. A `VtSelectionStyle` creates it and `VtSelectionIndicator` calls `Apply` every frame while the unit is shown, then destroys it. Subclass it for a custom look, either from a style of your own or as a component on the prefab of a `VtPrefabSelectionStyle`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `abstract void Apply(in VtSelectionMarkerState state, float deltaTime)` | Show `state`: place, size and colour the marker. |

## VtSelectionMarkerState

Struct.

What a selection marker shows this frame. Passed to `VtSelectionMarker.Apply`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtUnit Unit` | The unit the marker belongs to. |
| `Vector3 Position` | The unit position in world space, at its feet. |
| `float Radius` | Marker radius in world units: the unit radius plus the indicator padding. |
| `Color Color` | Colour for the unit relation, faded for a hovered unit that is not selected. |
| `VtSelectionRelation Relation` | How the unit relates to the selecting side. |
| `bool IsSelected` | True when the unit is selected. |
| `bool IsPrimary` | True when the unit is the primary selection. |
| `bool IsHovered` | True when the pointer is over the unit. |

## VtSelectionSet

Class.

An ordered set of selected units. The first unit is the primary selection: the one a unit frame shows and single-target abilities fall back to. Pure C#, so any input scheme can keep one and tests need no scene. Every call that changes the set raises `OnChanged` once; calls that change nothing raise nothing.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IReadOnlyList<VtUnit> Units { get; }` | The selected units, primary first. Can hold destroyed units until `PruneDestroyed` runs. |
| `int Count { get; }` | Number of selected units. |
| `VtUnit Primary { get; }` | The primary selected unit, or null when nothing is selected. |
| `int MaxCount { get; set; }` | Most units the set holds. 0 = no limit. Lowering it drops units from the end. |
| `event Action OnChanged` | Fires after the selection changed. |
| `bool Contains(VtUnit unit)` | True when `unit` is selected. |
| `void SelectOnly(VtUnit unit)` | Select only `unit`. Null clears the selection. |
| `void Set(IEnumerable<VtUnit> selection)` | Replace the selection with `selection`, in order, without nulls or duplicates. |
| `void Add(VtUnit unit)` | Add `unit` after the units already selected. |
| `void AddRange(IEnumerable<VtUnit> selection)` | Add every unit in `selection` after the units already selected. |
| `void Remove(VtUnit unit)` | Remove `unit`. The next unit becomes primary when the primary is removed. |
| `void Toggle(VtUnit unit)` | Remove `unit` if it is selected, otherwise add it. |
| `void Clear()` | Deselect every unit. |
| `bool PruneDestroyed()` | Drop destroyed units. Returns true when any were dropped. |

## VtSelectionRules

Static class.

The rules selection runs on, as pure functions: which units can be selected, how a unit relates to the selecting side, and which units a screen rectangle picks.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static VtSelectionRelation Relation(VtFaction viewer, VtUnit unit)` | How `unit` relates to a selecting side of faction `viewer`. |
| `static bool CanSelect(VtUnit unit, bool allowDead)` | True when `unit` exists, is active, and its definition allows selection. Dead units count only when `allowDead` is true. |
| `static void UnitsInScreenRect(IEnumerable<VtUnit> candidates, Rect screenRect, Func<Vector3, Vector3> worldToScreen, VtFaction viewer, VtBoxSelectionFilter filter, List<VtUnit> results)` | Fill `results` with the selectable, living units whose position falls inside `screenRect`, then narrow them with `filter`. `worldToScreen` maps a world position to screen pixels with the depth in z; units at or behind the camera are skipped. |
| `static void ApplyFilter(List<VtUnit> units, VtFaction viewer, VtBoxSelectionFilter filter)` | Narrow `units` in place with `filter`, keeping their order. |

## Enums

### VtFaction

Team or allegiance of a `VtUnit`. Units of different factions fight each other unless either is Neutral; AI targeting, splash damage and projectiles all respect it.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Neutral` | Unaffiliated or ambient — not targeted, not hostile. |
| `Player` | The local player and their summons / pets. |
| `Enemy` | Scripted hostile units (waves, bosses). |
| `Wildlife` | Passive NPCs (deer, rabbits) — flee when attacked, don't aggro. |

### VtBoxSelectionFilter

Which units a box selection keeps when the box covers units of different sides.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `PreferOwnFaction` | Units of the selecting side if the box holds any, otherwise hostile units, otherwise the rest. |
| `OwnFactionOnly` | Only units of the selecting side. |
| `Everything` | Every selectable unit in the box. |

### VtSelectionRelation

How a selected or hovered unit relates to the selecting side. Marker colours follow it.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Friendly` | The same faction as the selecting side. |
| `Hostile` | A faction that fights the selecting side. |
| `Neutral` | Neither: neutral units, or factions that do not fight the selecting side. |
